Class TableUtils

java.lang.Object
UserFeatures.TableUtils
public class TableUtils extends Object
Utility class for creating formatted table outputs. Provides reusable methods for table formatting used across View, Compare, and BulkEdit.

  • Method Details

    • appendTableRow

      public static void appendTableRow(StringBuilder sb, String... columns)
      Appends a table row with aligned columns to the StringBuilder. First column is left-aligned (60 chars), remaining columns are right-aligned (20 chars each).
      Parameters:
      sb - The StringBuilder to append to
      columns - Variable number of column values (first column left-aligned, rest right-aligned)

    • appendSeparator

      public static void appendSeparator(StringBuilder sb, int width, char character)
      Appends a separator line (decorative line of repeated characters). Used for creating visual separation between sections of a table.
      Parameters:
      sb - The StringBuilder to append to
      width - Total width of the separator line
      character - The character to repeat (e.g., '=' for header/footer, '-' for section divider)

    • appendTitle

      public static void appendTitle(StringBuilder sb, String title, int width)
      Appends a centered title. Uses right-alignment with calculated padding to achieve centering effect.
      Parameters:
      sb - The StringBuilder to append to
      title - The title text to center
      width - Total width for centering

    • appendTableRowCustom

      public static void appendTableRowCustom(StringBuilder sb, int firstColumnWidth, int otherColumnWidth, String... columns)
      Appends a table row with custom column widths. Used primarily in BulkEdit preview tables which need wider columns.
      Parameters:
      sb - The StringBuilder to append to
      firstColumnWidth - Width of the first column
      otherColumnWidth - Width of all other columns
      columns - Variable number of column values
